description: Versioned canonical travel landmark and monument names with verified official source citations, URLs, and evidence records.

poi-tky-sensoji.evidence: Official JNTO destination register documents 'Sensō-ji Temple' (Asakusa, Tokyo, 金龍山 浅草寺).

poi-kyo-kinkakuji.source: UNESCO World Heritage Centre / Shokoku-ji Religious Committee
poi-kyo-kinkakuji.evidence: UNESCO Historic Monuments of Ancient Kyoto listing includes Rokuon-ji (commonly Kinkaku-ji, 金閣寺).

poi-kyo-ginkakuji.source: UNESCO World Heritage Centre / Agency for Cultural Affairs (Bunkacho)
poi-kyo-ginkakuji.evidence: UNESCO Historic Monuments of Ancient Kyoto listing includes Jisho-ji (commonly Ginkaku-ji, 銀閣寺).

poi-kyo-ninnaji.notes: Canonical English is Ninna-ji; 'Ninna temple' is raw literal scraping
poi-kyo-ninnaji.source: UNESCO World Heritage Centre / Ninna-ji Official
poi-kyo-ninnaji.evidence: UNESCO listing documents 'Ninna-ji (仁和寺)'. Literal translation 'Ninna temple' lacks official standing.

poi-kyo-toji.notes: Canonical English is Tō-ji; 'East Temple' is raw literal scraping
poi-kyo-toji.source: UNESCO World Heritage Centre / Tō-ji Shingon Sect
poi-kyo-toji.evidence: UNESCO listing documents 'Tō-ji (Kyō-ō-gokoku-ji, 東寺)'. Literal translation 'East Temple' lacks official standing.

poi-kyo-sanjusangendo.evidence: Official Kyoto City destination directory documents 'Sanjūsangen-dō (三十三間堂)' with macron.

poi-ayt-hadrians-gate.source: T.C. Kültür ve Turizm Bakanlığı Antalya İl Kültür ve Turizm Müdürlüğü
poi-ayt-hadrians-gate.evidence: Official T.C. Kültür ve Turizm Bakanlığı directory entry: 'Hadrian Kapısı (Üçkapılar)'.

poi-ayt-suna-inan-kirac-kaleici-museum.source: AKMED / Koç Üniversitesi Vehbi Koç Vakfı
poi-ayt-suna-inan-kirac-kaleici-museum.evidence: Official AKMED museum registration documents 'Suna & İnan Kıraç Kaleiçi Museum'.

poi-ayt-antalya-museum.source: T.C. Kültür ve Turizm Bakanlığı Müzeler Genel Müdürlüğü
poi-ayt-antalya-museum.evidence: Official T.C. Müzeler Genel Müdürlüğü directory: 'Antalya Müzesi (Arkeoloji Müzesi)'.

poi-ayt-ataturk-house-museum.evidence: Official registry entry: 'Antalya Atatürk Evi ve Müzesi'.
